title: {Syn} Diffusion Models Learned to Denoise Images Into Existence
content:
Diffusion models learn to reverse a gradual noising process. Starting from noise, they repeatedly denoise until a coherent sample appears.

The framework became central to image generation because it offers stable training and high-quality samples, especially when paired with text conditioning.

Why it matters: ai papers keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
